d:
Uttarakhand men divali ke 11 din bad bhi ek divali manaee jati hai. ismen na sirf gharon men diye jalae jate hain, balki bhailo ko ghumakar mahaul roshan kiya jata hai. is parv ko uttarakhand men eegas-bagval ya burhi divali bhi kahte hain. kya hai is lokparv ko manane ki vajah, dekhie yah vidiyo.
Vidiyoh aasif ali
Editing aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
